hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git push"*|*"gh pr create"*) echo "[crg-hook] Refreshing code-review-graph index..." >&2; if ! command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[crg-hook] code-review-graph not installed (pip install code-review-graph); skipping." >&2; exit 0; fi; code-review-graph update 2>&1 >&2 || echo "[crg-hook] code-review-graph update failed (exit $?); continuing." >&2; echo "[crg-hook] Reminder: run /graphify . --update in-session to refresh graphify-out/ before opening the PR." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0
